description: This file defines the PdfNameObject class, representing an indirect name value in a PDF document within the PDFsharp library. The class provides methods for creation, comparison, and serialization of PDF name objects.

classes.name: PdfNameObject
classes.description: Represents an indirect name value used in PDFs, inheriting from PdfObject, with functionality for initialization, comparison, and serialization.

methods.name: PdfNameObject
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the value to a placeholder slash.

methods.name: PdfNameObject
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with a document and string value, validating that the value starts with a slash.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides object.Equals, compares the Value property to another object.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Overrides object.GetHashCode, returns hash based on the Value property.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Value, intended to be the name starting with a slash.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Checks for equality between PdfNameObject and a string.

methods.name: operator !=
methods.description: Checks for inequality between PdfNameObject and a string.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the object to a PDF writer, writing the name with its delimiters.
